meta_title: Quiet Translator — Understand What's Being Said
meta_desc: Quiet Translator turns live speech into your language in real time — for people living somewhere they're still learning the language. Available on iPhone and Android.
og_desc: You're in the room, but out of the loop. Quiet Translator turns live speech into your language, as it happens.
hero_sub: Quiet Translator · Real-Time AI Voice Translation
hero_desc: You're in the room, but out of the loop. Quiet Translator turns live speech into your language as it happens — on screen, or straight into your earpiece.

mode_meet: Best in quiet rooms and conferences.
mode_chat: For quick exchanges and short phrases.
mode_talk: Captures every speaker as they talk.
problem_text: Heavy machinery, ambient hum, and crowded factory floors make team communication nearly impossible. Standard translation apps fail — their microphone configs can't isolate voice, and sentence-by-sentence delays are unacceptable on the production floor.
solution_text: Quiet Translator uses forced microphone routing and an Environment Noise Filter to cut through background interference. Speak into the main mic, get translated audio directly in your earpiece — without distracting the people around you.
f1_desc: Quiet / Normal / Noisy. Each mode tunes pause suppression and audio sensitivity to match your exact environment.
f2_desc: Speak into the phone mic, hear the translation in your earpiece. Translation stays private — no speaker blasting in crowded rooms.
f3_desc: WebSocket-based audio pipeline. Translation appears word-by-word as you speak — no waiting for full sentences.
f4_desc: English, Arabic, Chinese (Mandarin), Czech, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese.
f5_desc: MEET / CHAT / TALK — each chip stores your preferred audio settings for different situations. One tap to switch.
f6_desc: Audio is streamed and immediately discarded. Nothing is saved — no recordings, no transcripts, no conversation logs. Ever.
t5_role: Designed for iOS and Android devices
